verdict.rationale: Supabase Auth is a hosted SaaS service that processes user data, so an AI-training opt-out or no-training commitment is a fair privacy question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack addresses AI model training, data-use policies or opt-out controls; the items cover authentication, JWTs, SSO, MFA and RLS only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
